name: Family Love
overview: Scripture reveals that family love is grounded in honoring and respecting one another, beginning with the command to honor parents for a blessed life (Exodus 20:12). Children are portrayed as a divine heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), emphasizing the sacredness of family bonds. The instruction to train children in God's commandments (Proverbs 3:1; 22:6) highlights the responsibility of nurturing faith and character within the family. Husbands are called to love their wives as themselves, and wives are to respect their husbands, reflecting Christ-centered mutual love and reverence in the marital relationship (Ephesians 5:28, 33).
